from scipy.optimize import least_squares
def run(name, f, npar, ntry=60, seed=0):
    rng=np.random.default_rng(seed)
    best=None
    for _ in range(ntry):
        p0=rng.normal(0,1,npar)
        try:
            r=least_squares(lambda p: f(p)-sigma, p0, max_nfev=3000)

        except Exception: pass
    print(name, best[0], np.round(best[1],4))
